cross_verification.note: Costa Rica's Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería (DGME) does not publish a citizen-facing passport photo specification because passport photos are captured biometrically in person at Migración offices, banks, or Correos de Costa Rica — confirmed via the official requirements list at migracion.go.cr/pasaportes-permisos-de-salida/, which lists only a valid cédula and proof of payment as required items for an adult passport application (no photo submission item). Since no official numeric spec is published for citizen-submitted photos, size/background/head_height and the restriction fields are left unverified rather than matched against or flagged as conflicting with the DB's figures. Third-party photo-service sites cite 2x2in/51x51mm figures, but these are excluded per the truthfulness gate as non-official sources.
